gloss: to grow up, to be raised

definitions.gloss: to grow up, to be raised
definitions.explanation: To develop from childhood to adulthood.
To become bigger or more mature.

examples.english: I grew up in the countryside.

examples.japanese: {野菜|やさい}がよく{育|そだ}つ。
{愛情|あいじょう}をもって{育|そだ}てられた。
この{木|き}は{大|おお}きく{育|そだ}った。
{東京|とうきょう}で{育|そだ}った。
{厳|きび}しい{環境|かんきょう}で{育|そだ}った。
examples.english: I was raised in a strict environment.

examples.japanese: {苗|なえ}がすくすくと{育|そだ}っている。
{裕福|ゆうふく}な{家庭|かてい}で{育|そだ}った。
examples.english: I grew up in a wealthy family.

examples.japanese: {花|はな}が{美|うつく}しく{育|そだ}った。

notes:
{育|そだ}つ is an intransitive godan verb meaning to grow up or develop.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive)
- Pair: {育|そだ}てる (transitive, to raise)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- Xで{育|そだ}つ: to grow up in X
- {田舎|いなか}で{育|そだ}った: grew up in the countryside
- すくすくと{育|そだ}つ: to grow vigorously
- {大|おお}きく{育|そだ}つ: to grow large

SUBJECTS:
- People: {子供|こども}が{育|そだ}つ (child grows up)
- Plants: {野菜|やさい}が{育|そだ}つ (vegetables grow)
- Abstract: {才能|さいのう}が{育|そだ}つ (talent develops)

RELATED WORDS:
- {育|そだ}てる: to raise (transitive)
- {育児|いくじ}: childcare
- {成長|せいちょう}: growth
